implemented: Replaces universal model X<-35 defeat with species source integer-object thresholds: default-100, pole/giant-150, football/catapult/zomboni-175, dancer/backup/snorkel-130. Model anchor maps to raw object X as X-30.

Captures integer raw X before actions, because ordinary Update synchronizes mX after UpdatePlaying. Checks after the action branch, including continue branches, while retaining rising/immobilized/blown-away/kelp exclusions.
A living head triggers defeat at inclusive edge. Represented headless states receive1800 shield-bypassing damage at edge+70. Removes prior headless X<35 unconditional death.
Backward walkers leave at post-motion raw floating X>850 without kills or loot; ice/butter keep them on board until mobility resumes.
No new arrays, maps, saved fields, assets, dependencies or render loops. Existing backward filtering pass remains; per-zombie action branches share the finally check.
